title: SEO i content marketing
SEO and content marketing
summary: Namjera pretrage, struktura članka, E-E-A-T i optimizacija za AI pretragu.
Search intent, article structure, E-E-A-T and optimizing for AI search.

q: Spojite namjeru pretrage s primjerom upita.
Match the search intent with an example query.
explain: Sadržaj mora odgovarati namjeri, ne samo riječi.
Content must match the intent, not just the words.

q: Što je search intent?
What is search intent?
explain: Isti upit može imati različite namjere.
The same query can have different intents.

q: Meta naslov je okvirno do oko 60 znakova da ne bude skraćen.
A meta title is roughly up to about 60 characters so it isn't truncated.
explain: Prikaz ovisi o širini, pa je to okvir.
Display depends on width, so it's a guideline.

q: Naslovi H1 i H2 čine ___ članka.
H1 and H2 headings make up the ___ of an article.
explain: Jasna struktura pomaže ljudima i tražilicama.
A clear structure helps people and search engines.

q: Složite izradu članka.
Order article production.
steps: Add your own experience and examples
explain: Vlastito iskustvo je razlika prema generičkom tekstu.
Your own experience is what sets you apart from generic text.

q: Koji pristup je bolji?
Which approach is better?
a: Ponavljam ključnu riječ 30 puta.
I repeat the keyword 30 times.
b: Odgovaram na namjeru, prirodno uz srodne pojmove.
I answer the intent, naturally with related terms.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?
bad: Write an SEO article about coffee.

t: Write a long article about coffee.
Ti si SEO urednik. Napravi outline (H1, 5×H2, FAQ) za „kako odabrati mlin za kavu” za početnike. Predloži meta naslov (≤60 znakova) i opis (≤155).
You are an SEO editor. Make an outline (H1, 5×H2, FAQ) for “how to choose a coffee grinder” for beginners. Suggest a meta title (≤60 chars) and description (≤155).
Write an article full of keywords.
why: Ključne riječi bez smisla ne pomažu.

explain: An outline before text saves rewrites.

q: AI može predložiti srodne pojmove, ali volumene pretrage treba provjeriti u alatu za ključne riječi.
AI can suggest related terms, but search volumes must be checked in a keyword tool.
explain: Model ne zna točne brojke pretraga.
The model doesn't know exact search numbers.

title: E-E-A-T, AI pretraga i provjera kvalitete
E-E-A-T, AI search and quality checks

q: Što je E-E-A-T?
What is E-E-A-T?
Masovno objavljivanje nepregledanog AI teksta bez dodane vrijednosti riskira nisku kvalitetu.
Mass-publishing unreviewed AI text with no added value risks low quality.
explain: Value for the reader is the yardstick.

q: E-E-A-T: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness i ___.
E-E-A-T: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness and ___.
Spojite praksu s koristi.
Match the practice with its benefit.
pairs: An author with a name and experience
Machines understand the page more easily
explain: These practices raise the text's value.

q: Što je optimizacija za AI odgovore (GEO/AEO)?
What is optimizing for AI answers (GEO/AEO)?
options: Jasni odgovori, struktura, činjenice koje se mogu citirati i izvori
Clear answers, structure, citable facts and sources
explain: AI pretraga cilja na jasne, provjerljive odgovore.
AI search favours clear, verifiable answers.

q: Složite provjeru AI nacrta.
Order a check of an AI draft.
Što je bolja strategija?
Which strategy is better?
a: Objavim 100 AI članaka dnevno.
I publish 100 AI articles a day.
b: Objavim 4 provjerena članka s vlastitim podacima.
I publish 4 verified articles with my own data.

q: Dodirnite izmišljenu statistiku.
Tap the invented statistic.
segments: Dobar opis proizvoda pomaže pri odlučivanju.
A good product description helps decision-making.
Prema Googleovoj studiji iz 2023., 91% kupaca čita samo prva dva retka opisa.
According to a 2023 Google study, 91% of shoppers read only the first two lines of a description.
explain: Precizna brojka bez poveznice na izvor.
A precise figure with no link to a source.

title: Email, CRM i automatizacija
Email, CRM and automation
summary: Segmentacija, flowovi, personalizacija, chatbotovi i automatizacije (Zapier, Make, n8n, MCP).
Segmentation, flows, personalization, chatbots and automation (Zapier, Make, n8n, MCP).

q: Spojite flow s okidačem.
Match the flow with its trigger.
explain: Flowovi rade 24/7 nakon što se jednom postave.

q: Što je segmentacija?
What is segmentation?
options: Dijeljenje liste prema ponašanju ili interesu
Splitting the list by behaviour or interest

q: Slanje marketinških emailova traži valjanu pravnu osnovu, najčešće privolu.
Sending marketing emails needs a valid legal basis, most often consent.
explain: GDPR i pravila o e-privatnosti. Provjeri sa stručnjakom.
GDPR and e-privacy rules. Check with an expert.

q: Personalizacija nije samo ime, nego i ___ kupca.
Personalization isn't only the name, but the customer's ___.
explain: Behaviour says more than a name.

q: Složite izradu welcome flowa.
Order building a welcome flow.
Što je bolje?
Which is better?
a: Isti email svima.
The same email to everyone.
b: Različit email za nove i stare kupce.
A different email for new and existing customers.

q: Koji podaci smiju u prompt radi personalizacije?
Which data may go into a prompt for personalization?
explain: A segment description is enough for the model.

q: Napišite prompt za welcome seriju emailova.
Write a prompt for a welcome email series.

label: Navodi broj emailova
States the number of emails
hint: State how many emails you need.

model: Ti si email marketer web trgovine kavom. Napiši welcome seriju od 3 emaila za nove pretplatnike: dan 0, 2 i 5. Svaki ima predmet do 45 znakova i jedan CTA; zadnji nudi prvu narudžbu s besplatnom dostavom.

You are an email marketer for a coffee web shop. Write a 3-email welcome series for new subscribers: day 0, 2 and 5. Each has a subject up to 45 characters and one CTA; the last offers a first order with free delivery.

explain: Broj, razmaci, publika i CTA čine seriju spremnom.
Number, timing, audience and CTA make the series ready.

q: Kako graditi chatbot za podršku?
How do you build a support chatbot?
options: Baza znanja (RAG), jasna pravila i predaja čovjeku
A knowledge base (RAG), clear rules and a human handoff
explain: Bot koji zna svoje granice je koristan.
A bot that knows its limits is useful.

q: Chatbot treba imati jasnu opciju prebacivanja na čovjeka.
A chatbot should have a clear option to hand off to a human.
explain: Frustriran kupac ne smije ostati u petlji.
A frustrated customer mustn't be stuck in a loop.

q: Zapier, Make i n8n služe za izradu ___ između aplikacija.
Zapier, Make and n8n are used to build ___ between apps.
explain: Set it up once, it runs on its own.

q: Složite automatizaciju.
Order an automation.
Spojite dio automatizacije s primjerom.
Match the automation part with an example.
pairs: A new lead in a form
Summarize the enquiry and suggest a reply
Pošalji email i zapiši u CRM
Send an email and log it in the CRM
explain: The same skeleton for most automations.

q: Što je sigurnije?
Which is safer?
a: Automatski šalje AI odgovore bez pregleda.
It sends AI replies automatically without review.
b: Šalje nacrt na odobrenje.
It sends a draft for approval.
explain: Approval catches errors before the customer.

q: Što MCP donosi automatizacijama?
What does MCP bring to automations?
options: AI agent dobiva alate (CRM, kalendar) kroz standardno sučelje
The AI agent gets tools (CRM, calendar) through a standard interface

q: Svaku automatizaciju treba prvo testirati na malom uzorku.
Every automation should be tested on a small sample first.
explain: Greška na 5 kontakata je manja od greške na 5000.
A mistake on 5 contacts is smaller than on 5,000.

title: Analitika i izvještavanje
Analytics and reporting
summary: KPI-jevi, GA4, UTM, izvještaji uz AI, eksperimenti i ROI.
KPIs, GA4, UTM, AI-assisted reports, experiments and ROI.

q: Spojite metriku sa značenjem.
Match the metric with its meaning.
pairs: Share of visitors who complete a goal
explain: Metrika bez cilja je samo broj.
A metric without a goal is just a number.

q: Čemu služe UTM parametri?
What are UTM parameters for?
explain: Bez UTM-a promet često završi kao „direktan”.
Without UTMs traffic often shows as “direct”.

q: U GA4 se interakcije bilježe kao događaji (events).
In GA4 interactions are recorded as events.
explain: Sve je događaj, od pregleda stranice do klika.
Everything is an event, from a page view to a click.

q: UTM: utm_source, utm_medium i utm____.
UTM: utm_source, utm_medium and utm____.
Složite postavljanje praćenja.
Order setting up tracking.
Što prvo napraviti prije traženja uvida od AI-ja iz izvoza?
What should you do first before asking AI for insights from an export?
options: Očistiti podatke, objasniti stupce, navesti cilj i razdoblje
Clean the data, explain the columns, state the goal and period
Send raw data with no explanation

q: Koji upit je bolji?
Which request is better?
a: „Što je dobro?” bez podataka.
“What's good?” with no data.
b: Tablica, definiran KPI i razdoblje.
A table, a defined KPI and a period.

q: Dobar KPI povezan je s poslovnim ciljem.
A good KPI is tied to a business goal.
explain: Lajkovi bez prodaje nisu uvijek uspjeh.
Likes without sales aren't always success.

q: Što tražiš od AI-ja u izvještaju?
What do you ask AI for in a report?
options: Što se promijenilo, mogući uzroci i preporuke, uz provjeru brojeva
What changed, possible causes and recommendations, with numbers verified

q: AI može pogriješiti u računu pa ključne brojke provjeri u alatu.
AI can miscalculate, so verify key numbers in the tool.
explain: Spot-check by hand or by formula.

q: ROI je (dobit − trošak) podijeljeno s ___.
ROI is (profit − cost) divided by ___.
explain: It shows return per euro invested.

q: Složite mjesečni izvještaj.
Order a monthly report.
steps: Ask for a summary and anomalies

q: Spojite pojam sa značenjem.
Match the term with its meaning.
pairs: Which channel gets credit for a conversion

q: Koji zaključak je ispravniji?
Which conclusion is sounder?
a: Rast klikova je zbog novog naslova (sigurno).
The click growth is due to the new headline (for sure).
b: Rast se poklapa s novim naslovom. Testiraj A/B da potvrdiš uzrok.
The growth coincides with the new headline. A/B test to confirm the cause.

q: Koliko podataka treba za zaključak eksperimenta?
How much data do you need to conclude an experiment?
options: Enough for a statistically reliable sample
explain: Premalo podataka daje sreću, ne znanje.
Too little data gives luck, not knowledge.

q: Napišite prompt za mjesečni izvještaj kampanje.
Write a prompt for a monthly campaign report.

label: Traži provjeru ili izvor brojki
Asks to verify or cite numbers
hint: Dodaj: navedi iz kojeg stupca je koja brojka.
Add: state which column each number comes from.

model: Ti si marketing analitičar. Iz priložene tablice za listopad sastavi izvještaj: KPI (CPA, ROAS), glavne promjene i anomalije prema rujnu te 3 preporuke. Uz svaku brojku navedi iz kojeg je stupca i označi što treba provjeriti.

You are a marketing analyst. From the attached October table write a report: KPIs (CPA, ROAS), main changes and anomalies versus September and 3 recommendations. Next to each number state the column it came from and flag what needs checking.

explain: Naming the source of each number makes checking easy.

title: Vizuali, video i audio
Visuals, video and audio
summary: Promptovi za slike i video, konzistentnost brenda, prava i označavanje.
Image and video prompts, brand consistency, rights and labelling.

q: Što ulazi u prompt za sliku?
What goes into an image prompt?
options: Subjekt, stil, svjetlo, kompozicija i format
Subject, style, lighting, composition and format
explain: The more specific, the closer to your vision.

q: Spojite element prompta s primjerom.
Match the prompt element with an example.
pairs: A cup of coffee on a wooden table
Kadar odozgo s mjestom za tekst
Top-down shot with space for text

q: Tekst unutar generiranih slika često ima greške pa ga dodaj u uređivaču.
Text inside generated images often has errors, so add it in an editor.
Omjer slike za Instagram Story je 9:___.
The aspect ratio of an Instagram Story is 9:___.
explain: Vertikalni 9:16 vrijedi i za Reels i TikTok.
Vertical 9:16 also fits Reels and TikTok.

q: Složite izradu videa.
Order producing a video.
Koji prompt je bolji?
Which prompt is better?
a: Napravi lijepu sliku kave.
Make a nice picture of coffee.
b: Fotografija proizvoda: bidon na stolu, meko jutarnje svjetlo, kadar odozgo, prazan prostor za tekst, 4:5.
Product photo: a bottle on a table, soft morning light, top-down shot, empty space for text, 4:5.
explain: Navedi i format i prostor za tekst.
State the format and space for text.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?
bad: Make an image for the ad.

t: Napravi kreativnu sliku koja se sviđa.
Make a creative image people like.
Fotografija termosice na kamenu u šumi, hladno jutarnje svjetlo, plitka dubina polja, 1:1, prazan prostor gore za naslov. Bez teksta u slici.
A thermos on a rock in a forest, cold morning light, shallow depth of field, 1:1, empty space on top for the headline. No text in the image.
why: Subjekt, svjetlo, format i zabrana teksta.
Subject, light, format and a no-text rule.

explain: Format determines where the ad goes.

q: Svaki AI vizual treba pregledati zbog grešaka na rukama, tekstu i logotipima.
Every AI visual should be checked for errors in hands, text and logos.
explain: Greške na slici najbrže uoče kupci.

q: Što ide u brand kit za prompt?
What goes into a brand kit for prompts?
options: Boje, fontovi, stil i što izbjegavati
Colours, fonts, style and what to avoid
explain: A brand kit keeps visuals consistent.

q: Referentne slike i vodič stila pomažu konzistentnosti.
Reference images and a style guide help consistency.
explain: Isti vodič koriste svi u timu.
Everyone on the team uses the same guide.

q: Generiranje u stilu živućeg umjetnika bez dopuštenja je ___.
Generating in a living artist's style without permission is ___.
Spojite situaciju s postupkom.
Match the situation with the action.
explain: Rights are part of the job.

q: Složite QA vizuala.
Order visual QA.
Zašto arhivirati promptove i postavke?
Why archive prompts and settings?
explain: Isti rezultat možeš ponoviti za kampanju.
You can recreate the same result for a campaign.

q: Što je ispravnije?
Which is more appropriate?
a: Koristim sliku s Googlea kao referencu i prodajem.
I use an image from Google as a reference and sell it.
b: Koristim vlastite ili licencirane reference.
I use my own or licensed references.

q: Napišite prompt za sliku proizvoda u stilu brenda.
Write a prompt for a product image in brand style.

model: Fotografija proizvoda: čelični bidon na drvenom stolu, minimalistički stil, meko jutarnje svjetlo, zelena i bež paleta brenda, kadar odozgo, omjer 4:5, prazan prostor za naslov. Bez teksta i bez logotipa u slici.

Product photo: a steel bottle on a wooden table, minimalist style, soft morning light, the brand's green and beige palette, top-down shot, 4:5 ratio, empty space for a headline. No text and no logos in the image.

explain: Paleta i zabrane drže vizual u brendu.
Palette and bans keep the visual on brand.

title: Lov na AI greške u marketingu
Hunting AI mistakes in marketing
summary: Halucinacije, generički ton, pristranost i QA kontrolna lista.
Hallucinations, generic tone, bias and a QA checklist.

q: Dodirnite izmišljenu tvrdnju.
Tap the invented claim.
segments: Video objave često dobivaju više angažmana.
Video posts often get more engagement.
Istraživanje Sveučilišta u Zagrebu iz 2022. dokazalo je da su plave tipke 23,6% uspješnije.
A 2022 University of Zagreb study proved blue buttons are 23.6% more effective.
Testirajte boje tipki na vlastitoj publici.
Test button colours on your own audience.
explain: Precizna brojka i institucija bez izvora.
A precise figure and institution with no source.

q: Što napraviti s generičkim frazama poput „u današnjem brzom svijetu”?
What should you do with generic phrases like “in today's fast-paced world”?
options: Replace them with a concrete detail

q: Pitanje „jesi li siguran?” pouzdan je način provjere činjenica.
Asking “are you sure?” is a reliable way to fact-check.
explain: The model often confirms its own mistake.

q: Spojite znak s postupkom.
Match the sign with the action.
pairs: A precise figure with no source
Find the source or delete it
Dodaj vlastite primjere i glas brenda
Add your own examples and brand voice
explain: Each sign has a quick fix.

q: Tekst koji zvuči isto za svaki brend ima generički ___ ton.
Text that sounds the same for every brand has a generic ___ tone.
explain: A recognizable “AI tone” puts readers off.

q: Složite uklanjanje generičkog tona.
Order removing a generic tone.
steps: Ask for concrete details and examples

q: Koji tekst zvuči ljudskije?
Which text sounds more human?
a: Naša inovativna, revolucionarna kava mijenja sve.
Our innovative, revolutionary coffee changes everything.
b: Pržimo u Zadru, svaki tjedan nova serija, mljevenje po tvom aparatu.
We roast in Zadar, a new batch every week, ground for your machine.
explain: Konkretni detalji vjerodostojniji su od pridjeva.
Concrete details are more credible than adjectives.

q: Koja preinaka je najbolja?
Which rewrite is best?
bad: Rewrite the text to sound better.

t: Prepravi kao topao lokalni brend: kratke rečenice, bez klišeja („revolucionarno”, „inovativno”), dodaj jedan konkretan detalj. Zadrži činjenice, ništa ne dodaj.
Rewrite as a warm local brand: short sentences, no clichés (“revolutionary”, “innovative”), add one concrete detail. Keep the facts, add nothing.

explain: „Ništa ne dodaj” štiti od novih izmišljotina.

q: Što je pristranost u AI tekstu?
What is bias in AI text?
options: Ponavljanje stereotipa iz podataka za učenje
explain: Model uči iz ljudskih tekstova, pa i njihovih predrasuda.
The model learns from human texts, and their prejudices too.

q: Pregled inkluzivnosti dio je QA-a prije objave.
An inclusivity review is part of QA before publishing.
Provjere prije objave vodimo kao ___ (popis točaka).
We run pre-publish checks as a ___ (list of items).
Spojite provjeru s pitanjem.
Match the check with its question.
pairs: Does it sound like our brand?

q: Složite QA tijek.
Order the QA flow.
Koja persona je bolja?
Which persona is better?
a: „Žene vole ružičasto.”
“Women love pink.”
b: Persona temeljena na ponašanju i podacima iz ankete.
A persona based on behaviour and survey data.

q: Što provjeriti kad AI generira slike ljudi?
What do you check when AI generates images of people?
options: Raznolikost, stereotipe i oznaku da je AI
Diversity, stereotypes and an AI label

q: Dodirnite rečenicu sa stereotipom.
Tap the sentence with a stereotype.
segments: Naš alat je jednostavan za sve timove.
Our tool is easy for all teams.
Žene će ga lakše koristiti jer vole jednostavne stvari, a muškarci snažne funkcije.
Women will find it easier because they like simple things, and men powerful features.
